title: Breakup on Monday. New era by Tuesday.
caption:
Breakup on Monday, countdown and confetti by Tuesday, era number four.
Pluto got reclassified as a dwarf planet and didn't even wave. Leo is still negotiating for one spotlight.
Which sign announces their eras?
